question: The Bankruptcy Legislative Reforms Committee (BLRC) was set up in which of the following years?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2014**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** The Bankruptcy Legislative Reforms Committee (BLRC) was set up in the year 2014. The committee was formed to review and suggest changes in the existing bankruptcy laws in India. The BLRC submitted its report in November 2015, which led to the enactment of the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code (IBC) in 2016.
